popup_debug_backup_hint.message: Export reads every Amazon list's items (slow — one tab per list) and bundles them with the local mc.* storage into a JSON file. Restore recreates each custom list on Amazon from that file (also slow — drives Add-to-List per item). Watch the status window for progress. Restore does not touch entitlement or overwrite storage.

popup_debug_logs_hint.message: Copies the extension version, current state, and recent logs from every context (service worker, content scripts, popup) to the clipboard. Keep Developer mode on, reproduce the issue, then copy and send the result to support.

popup_settings_relabel_sub.message: On relabels Amazon’s Lists page as “Your Styx Carts” and adds “Cart” to each of your list names (e.g. “Jared’s List” → “Jared’s List Cart”). Off leaves Amazon untouched.

popup_settings_fabpulse_sub.message: The round Styx button glows orange on Amazon pages as a reminder to use it. Turn off for a static button.

popup_settings_sidepanel_sub.message: On docks Styx as a side panel (default). Off opens a compact popup from the toolbar instead.

popup_settings_devmode_sub.message: Shows the debug panel at the bottom of the popup and enables verbose logs in the service worker console. Safe to leave off.

popup_settings_affiliate_body.message: When you send a whole cart to Amazon, Styx uses Amazon’s bulk add-to-cart endpoint, which won’t add your items unless the link carries an Amazon Associates tag (tag=styxmcart-20). Styx supplies a placeholder tag only so bulk cart restore works — it is not a registered Associates account, and Styx earns no commission or referral fee from your purchases.
